svg.title: Structural engineer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as structural engineer, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A large I-section stands beside a separate rectangular frame with one diagonal brace. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
